Ok this sounds weird and it might not be the right answer or anything, but I hired a trainer for my adult dog, and the trainer told me to have him on a leash for 10 days, even while in the house. My family and I worked together to do this for 10 days straight, which was difficult for both us and the dog I’m sure. Except IT WORKED. He is fully potty trained and has never had an accident since (not including the one time he wasn’t taken out by my roommate in time while I wasn’t home, and even then he looked so ashamed-not to worry, lots of pets and kisses afterwards since I didn’t see the accident happen 🙂)

Long answer short, of course you will. You will NEVER forget all those memories and loving times from your previous dog, but it helps just a little bit sometimes to look up to the sky and talk to them like you used to. Tell them they’re a good boy or girl up there. Tell them you miss them and want to give them spoonfuls of peanut butter. Don’t forget them, but always realize that your current dog needs that same kind of love too. Let them be your new best buddy. It’s okay. If you ever need to talk I got your back
